name: charlie-project-stewardship
description: A lightweight, repository-local stewardship harness that preserves project context and completion evidence for coding agents without imposing a fixed workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Durable project context without a rigid workflow.
interface.longDescription: A repository-local stewardship layer for capable coding agents. Five independent capabilities bound ambiguity-sensitive work, bootstrap only missing project context, preserve verified knowledge, relay genuinely long-running plans, and choose completion evidence from the actual change surface. Every capability is optional; the plugin does not impose a fixed development workflow or require an external task system.
defaultPrompt: Turn this complex request into a bounded task contract with explicit acceptance evidence.
Inspect this project and add only the stewardship files it genuinely needs.
Save this verified decision with its scope, evidence, and re-check condition.
